subject: Hobgoblin Warrior
picture: One medium athletic hobgoblin soldier leads a shield-wall drill in an underground barracks tunnel. He is taller than a goblin, with smaller pointed ears, a broad flat nose, no tusks, and an upright military posture. Three overlapping rectangular shields are held in a line, feet planted in a marked floor lane. A large shield rack stands against the wall. The tunnel has a stone ceiling, large block walls, and a white doorway at the far end.
